name: Rare earth elements
note: Brazil ionic-clay projects (Goiás, Minas Gerais); Paraguay prospecting.
uses: Permanent magnets for electric motors and wind turbines, catalysts, polishing powders, phosphors and defence electronics.
why_it_matters: China mines most of the world's rare earths and refines nearly all of them; the region's ionic-clay projects in Brazil are among the few deposits outside Asia that could change that, which is why both powers watch them.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
